scope: New real GIMP layer-visibility demonstration of the unchanged existing master; not a new ParaView simulation or original authoring replay.

environment.native_execution: Official typed GIMP session tools through real loopback HTTP MCP; asynchronous Core jobs awaited.

attribution.basis: Requested configuration is preserved separately. No accepted runtime configuration receipt was available; no confirmed model or effort claim is made. Historical model records are unchanged.

capture.audio_intent: Intentionally silent; listening is not applicable.
capture.method: One continuous X11 capture of the exact task-owned GIMP window, verified against its process identity; live typed MCP group-visibility changes during capture. No desktop-wide capture.
capture.encoder: FFmpeg libx264, one thread, CRF 19, fast preset, faststart; no cuts, retiming, overlays, image synthesis or composited software UI.
capture.timing_note: Below are actual MCP request/terminal receipt times relative to capture process start, not claims of exact onscreen frame onset.

review.visual_observation: Five native groups appear in X/Y/Z/80 ms/150 ms order. The entire plate remains framed with GIMP menus and layer dock. Final frame holds all panels. Some long layer names are truncated by the dock width; full editable names remain in the original XCF.
review.browser_play_pause_resume_seek: not-tested at packaging; see exact-head browser CI

privacy.reviewed: Actual GIMP pixels, all 30 layer names, 19 text-layer payloads and image metadata. Only the task-owned window is included. No other application, notification, credential, local endpoint, machine path or user identity is included in public media.
privacy.raw_diagnostics: Private originals retained. This public file contains selected measured summaries, not a complete raw transcript.
privacy.asset_rights: Existing rights-reserved notice applies to the new media; no additional license grant.

research_before_capture.interpretation: The 2026 posts republish 2017 artist interviews, not evidence of a new 2026 trend. Use clear editing structure and native single-window context. No external artwork was copied. The retired plugin registry was not presented as a live store.
research_before_capture.selected_reuse: Existing free official dcc-mcp-gimp adapter; no additional art/plugin assets installed.

limits: Only Linux GIMP 3.0.4 was natively exercised.
The film reveals existing groups; it does not reconstruct the artwork or numerically animate the synthetic field.
Screen-capture bytes depend on display, timing and encoder; cross-machine video identity is not claimed.
The old full production qualification is preserved, not rerun.
